name: Untold Stories of the ER
description: Doctors recount the most memorable cases they’ve ever encountered. Unusual, touching, humorous or life-changing – no story is too big or too small when it comes to the ER.

videos.title: Celebration Stoppers
videos.overview: Celebrations morph into medical mania after their special occasions land them in the ER.

videos.title: Didn't See It Coming
videos.overview: A behind-the-scenes look at activity in a hospital emergency room.

videos.title: Party Fails
videos.overview: A night on the town quickly turns into a fiasco in the ER.

videos.title: Worst Day Ever
videos.overview: A first hand look at individuals who didn't expect to become human shish kabobs.

videos.title: Labor Pains
videos.overview: Pregnant women and their partners undergo unusual birth procedures in extraordinary circumstances.

videos.title: Baby 911
videos.overview: Infants' visits to the ER are featured.

videos.title: Sex Edition: Temptations
videos.overview: Outrageous stories of patients who end up in the ER after sex related injuries.

videos.title: Sex Edition: Secrets
videos.overview: Get an intimate look at the untold stories of patients who landed in the ER after sex-related injuries. From life-threatening to the light-hearted, mysterious to bizarre, hear their outrageous stories as told through the eyes of the doctors.

videos.title: Craziest Cases
videos.overview: This special features 10 of the craziest stories from the first 100 episodes of Untold Stories. Doctors never know what's coming through the ER doors, and in these cases they must first get over their own shock before they can start saving lives.

videos.title: My Job Is Mayhem
videos.overview: In order to get a snakebite victim the correct anti-venom, a doctor has to find the type of snake that he has been bitten by.

videos.title: The Big Save
videos.overview: The doctors treat patients with various problems. Two patients have internal bleeding, one passes out after drinking cold water, and a man who cut off his own hand with a meat cleaver because he was tired of the problems it was giving him.

videos.title: We Have a Heartbeat
videos.overview: An artist has to have his hand reattached after accidentally cutting it off while working on a new project.

videos.title: How Can This Happen
videos.overview: A 6-year-old boy who punctured his skull with a pitchfork is rushed into surgery; a woman refuses treatment by a black doctor.

videos.title: Call the Code
videos.overview: Victims of a plane crash bring reporters when they come to the small E.R. Meanwhile, a doctor faces a difficult decision about a teen patient.

videos.title: What a Day
videos.overview: A 33-year-old is declared brain-dead from a gunshot wound, and the victim's wife agrees to keep her husband on life support until his organs can be harvested and donated.

videos.title: We Need Further Tests
videos.overview: Cops arrive at the E.R. with a suspected criminal. Meanwhile, the doctors try their best to save a boy with severe head injuries.

videos.title: Surgery Won't Help
videos.overview: An X-ray reveals a five-inch piece of glass lodged in a man's brain.

videos.title: No Time to Think
videos.overview:
Whe a man's religion keeps him from getting the proper treatment for a snake bite, the doctors try to find some way to help him.

A circus performer bitten by a poisonous snake — requiring immediate antivenom and stabilization to prevent fatal envenomation.

A baby delivered in a car park — a rare and dangerous scenario where the team must manage both the newborn and the mother under unusual conditions.

Other urgent cases — possibly involving a 600‑pound patient in respiratory distress, a paralegal beaten up with a suspicious story, and other emergencies that demand rapid triage and intervention

videos.title: Red Blanket
videos.overview:
Comprised of three stories:

"Mother and Fetus Shot"

"Frozen from Fiji"

"Traveling Bullet"

videos.title: A Scary Feeling
videos.overview:
A teen brought in with a live cockroach stuck in his ear canal — a rare and unsettling injury requiring careful removal.

A man who has hacked open a can of spray paint and inhaled the fumes — a dangerous chemical inhalation case that can cause severe respiratory distress.

A man who runs screaming out of the ER shortly after bringing in his wife with chest pains — adding to the tension and unpredictability of the episode.

A man who loses his hand in a work accident — a traumatic injury requiring urgent surgical intervention.

A doctor who is afraid of bugs — highlighting the emotional and psychological challenges faced by medical staff

videos.title: A Day from Hell
videos.overview:
Chronically Ill Boy’s ER Visit – A five-year-old boy, already admitted to the ER multiple times in the past year, is brought in again. Doctors think the boy's being poisoned by his mother. The case highlights the ER’s role in identifying and protecting vulnerable children.

Shooting Victims and a Gun-Wielding Girlfriend – Two shooting victims arrive at the ER, followed shortly by the girlfriend of one of them, armed with a gun. The episode captures the tension and urgency of handling armed individuals in a hospital setting.

Hypothermia Case – A man suffering from severe hypothermia is rushed in. The medical team must work quickly to stabilize him before irreversible damage occurs.

PCP-Intoxicated Bouncer – A bouncer from a local club, high on PCP, bolts from the ER before his sedative takes effect. The episode shows the challenges of managing patients who are both intoxicated and at risk of respiratory failure.

videos.title: Prepare for the Worst
videos.overview: Members of rival gangs are admitted and their fellow gang members come to the ER; Sister Della Rosa is admitted with trouble breathing, and she doesn't want treatment; A surgeon loses his fingers in a saw accident; A patient has cut his fingers and tells conflicting stories about how it happened.

videos.title: No Down Time
videos.overview:
woman in an automobile accident on the day of her wedding — her injuries and the emotional weight of the event add urgency to her treatment

An elderly couple and their adult daughter admitted with bizarre symptoms — their condition is unusual and requires careful diagnosis  A man admitted with a knife sticking out of his neck — a traumatic injury that demands immediate surgical intervention

A drunk seven‑foot man who goes wild while strapped to a gurney — a bizarre and dangerous situation that tests staff control and medical judgment

videos.title: We Need a Miracle
videos.overview: Ten Critically Ill Teenagers: A group of teenagers are brought in after experimenting with drugs, suffering severe injuries that require urgent medical intervention  Tree Branch Impalement: A man arrives with a tree branch lodged through his neck, a rare and dangerous injury that demands immediate surgical attention  Rave Party Victims: Additional cases from a rave party are featured, showing the ER’s role in treating mass casualty incidents

videos.title: I Need Some Help Here
videos.overview: Pregnant Teen: The episode begins with paramedics treating a teenage girl who is unresponsive after a car accident. Upon examination, they discover that she is pregnant, adding urgency to her medical care as they work to stabilize her condition  Axe in the Head: Another significant case involves a patient who arrives at the ER with an axe embedded in his head. This shocking injury presents a unique challenge for the medical team as they assess the damage and determine the best course of action for treatment  Abdominal Pain Case: Additionally, a woman complaining of abdominal pain learns that she is pregnant, which adds a layer of complexity to her diagnosis and treatment

videos.title: How Can This Happen
videos.overview:
Skull Puncture by a Pitchfork

The episode opens with a harrowing trauma case: a young boy’s skull is punctured by a pitchfork, a severe injury that puts neurosurgeon Dr. Smith under extreme pressure. The medical team must act quickly to stabilize the child and prepare for possible life-saving surgery  Racial Incident in the ER

The second segment deals with a racially charged situation where a woman refuses treatment from a Black doctor. This case highlights the emotional and professional challenges faced by ER staff when dealing with patients who are unwilling to receive care due to prejudice

videos.title: Call the Code
videos.overview: A 21-year-old man has suffered internal injuries in a motorcycle accident.

videos.title: What a Day
videos.overview: A woman comes into the ER with severe abdominal pain and claims there is an alien in her stomach.

videos.title: Nothing's Working
videos.overview:
A young boy has a brain tumor

A husband walks into the ER and stabilizes his wife's condition by touching her forehead

A homeless woman, complaining of stomach pain, goes into labor.

videos.title: We Need Further Tests
videos.overview:
Intestinal evisceration: A man arrives with his intestine protruding, a life‑threatening condition requiring immediate surgery.

Hook impalement: A man is impaled in the throat by a hook while cutting down a tree.

Pregnant doctor in labor: A pregnant physician is treated by her own pregnant OB‑GYN.

Hunting accident: A hunter is accidentally shot, leading to a collapsed lung.

Classroom collapse: A woman collapses during a prenatal exercise class.

Suture line failure: A gang member’s facial laceration causes his sutures to burst, leading to unusual stabilization measures.

Other ER crises: A man crashes into the ER entrance, a patient with high fever and no blood pressure, and a physician who leaps onto a gurney to catch a baby during a delivery.

videos.title: Pressure is Building
videos.overview:
A boy is rushed in after breathing in an unspecified poisonous chemical. Has it permanently damaged his lungs?

A three-month-old baby loses consciousness for no apparent reason  A patient complaining of stomach cramps is pregnant.

videos.title: Surgery Won't Help
videos.overview:
Hostage situation in the ER: A depressed man walks in, pulls out a gun, and takes a doctor hostage  Clot suspicion: A retired aerospace engineer presents with leg pain, raising concerns for a blood clot

Medical student suicide attempt: A student, depressed after failing exams, attempts suicide in the ER

Unusual patient: A man brings his beagle into the ER

videos.title: Jaws of Life
videos.overview:
The doctors face one of their toughest cases ever when a patient that has been attacked by a mountain lion comes to the E.R. with the most severe injuries that the doctors have ever encountered.  Meanwhile, one woman complains of being dizzy but ends up actually being high.

Also, a young girl is stuck by thousands of needles after rolling down the side of a cliff.

Teen Impaled in Car Crash

A car carrying two teenage girls collides with a fence, sending a pole through the windshield and into the driver’s chest, continuing through the seat into the passenger’s thigh

. The ER team must act quickly to stabilize the patient, remove the embedded object, and address potential internal injuries.

Child Stung by Bees

A little girl is brought in after being stung by bees. The episode focuses on the medical response to allergic reactions, the need for rapid assessment, and the steps taken to prevent anaphylactic shock

videos.title: A Day at the Beach
videos.overview:
A man is shot through the heart while his store is being robbed.

Incident: A young boy is attacked by a shark while at the beach, sustaining severe injuries.

Ear Complaint

Incident: On the same on Halloween night, a lady is screaming in agony as there is something in her ear, and it needs to come out.

videos.title: Say Your Prayers
videos.overview:
Snake Bite Crisis: A man is bitten by a deadly rattlesnake and because of religious reasons cannot receive a blood transfusion; the ER doctors race to combat the toxins in his system without compromising his beliefs

Motorcycle Accident: A motorcyclist arrives at the ER with a branch impaled through his helmet into his neck, requiring immediate and careful intervention to prevent further injury

videos.title: A Life in Their Hands
videos.overview: Recurring ER case — a young girl who had been admitted a week earlier for a medical issue, treated, and discharged. When she returns, she is now unable to move from the waist down, raising concerns about a possible worsening condition or a new injury

videos.title: Code Green in the E.R.
videos.overview:
After a tornado strikes Oklahoma, a woman comes to the E.R. with a fence picket impaled through her head.

A stabbing victim undergoes a risky chest incision

A car accident brings a pet iguana into the ER.

videos.title: Exorcism in the E.R.
videos.overview:
The E.R. doctors have to reattach a 7-year-old boy's arm after he is involved in a truck accident.

Meanwhile, a teenage boy comes to the hospital unable to move his ankles and feet.

Anaphylactic Shock – A patient arrives in critical condition, going into anaphylactic shock, requiring rapid intervention to stabilize breathing and circulation

Severe Skin Rash – A man presents with a rash that is baffling to doctors and later causes him to collapse, likely due to a severe allergic reaction or systemic illness

Ninja Sword Self-Injury – A man stabs himself with a ninja sword, adding a dramatic and unusual element to the episode’s mix of medical urgency and patient behavior

videos.title: The Golden Hour
videos.overview:
A young boy is rushed to the emergency room immediately after a football game.

A Sergeant Home from Iraq with a Stab Wound – The episode opens with a U.S. Army sergeant returning from Iraq who has been stabbed in the heart.

A Woman with Earthworms in Her Arms – One of the most bizarre cases, this patient presents with earthworms embedded in her arms.

A Man Shot in His Ear – A young man arrives with a gunshot wound to his ear, requiring immediate surgical attention.

A Woman Overdosing on Diet Pills – The episode also covers a patient who has overdosed on diet pills, showcasing the dangers of substance abuse and the medical steps taken to reverse the effects

videos.title: Toilet Paper Eating Patient
videos.overview:
A skier runs into bad luck after hitting a tree at 50 miles per hour when his blood will not clot and the power goes out at the emergency room.

A woman with a habit of eating toilet paper complains of abdominal pains

A patient in a correctional facility is found unresponsive and running a high fever.

videos.title: Long Live the King
videos.overview:
Doctors have to not only worry about a patient's severed arm, but also the amount of damage that his liver and splein have suffered.

The Gypsy King

A man claiming to be the “king of the gypsies” arrives at the ER accompanied by a group of followers who refuse to leave his side

The Retired Admiral

A retired admiral is admitted with a rapidly worsening condition that baffles the doctors

videos.title: Coma Woman Surprise
videos.overview:
A boy that has been crushed under a heavy stack of drywall is brought in with a possibilty of multiple organ failure.

A plane crash sends the reporters swarming to a small community ER with three victims

A teenager has serious head trauma and the doctor must decide whether to bore holes in his head or wait for more help.

videos.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
videos.overview:
A woman on the way to her own wedding has a car accident and is sent to the ER with severe facial injuries.

Meanwhile, a prisoner comes to the ER, but the doctors are wary of him.

videos.title: Mystery of the Traveling Bullet
videos.overview:
A drunken cowboy ends up in the ER

The Traveling Bullet: In most gunshot wounds, a bullet exits the body at the same site it entered. Here, the bullet entered the thigh but continued through the body, striking another area — in this case, the chest — causing both leg and chest injuries

videos.title: An ER Miracle
videos.overview:
A young boy is brought in that has been ejected from a car which caused a severed head and doctors need to race to save his life

Cops bring in a man suspected of robbing a bank

A patient complains of chest pains.

videos.title: A Real Pain in the Neck
videos.overview:
Doctors must fight to save an injured police officer's legs.

While this happens, a royal prinncess has a hangover

A boy gets a blood clot and could die.

A multiple personality disorder patient comes in with strange markings all over her body and chest

A man is rushed to the ER with a 16-inch bar protruding from his neck.

videos.title: From ER to Rushing River
videos.overview:
A snakebite specialist finds it difficult to treat his own son.

A young boy who broke his leg was drugged up with weed

A golfer got a golf club through his head.

Train‑Injury: A young boy’s feet are crushed by a train, and ER surgeons race to save his life through urgent orthopedic intervention.

Stomach Pain Patient: A man with suspected perforated bowel faces family hesitation after a prior bad surgical outcome

Rapid Infection in a Firefighter: A rookie doctor struggles to convince her surgeon that a spreading infection in a female firefighter’s arm may be flesh‑eating bacteria, requiring aggressive treatment

Wilderness Rescue: A doctor undertakes a two‑hour wilderness trek to retrieve a hiker who has fallen into a creek

videos.title: Shot Through the Heart
videos.overview: A jewelry shop owner undergoes open-heart surgery after being shot during a robbery.

videos.title: Sudden Killers
videos.overview:
A Woman is attacked by mountain lion.

A difficult lady has abdominal problems.

A child with large thorns and splinters all over her body

videos.title: Hidden Dangers
videos.overview:
A man comes into the ER coughing up blood

A patient complains of having bugs in her scalp

A 15-year-old hit in the head with a baseball appears to have a concussion, but a CT scan reveals massive brain bleeding, and he suffers kidney failure.

A patient has lost a finger in a snow blower.

videos.title: Deadly Diagnosis
videos.overview: An 11-year-old girl has streptococcal pneumonia, which has a high fatality rate.

videos.title: Life and Limb
videos.overview:
Seven‑year‑old boy who was struck by a truck and suffered a traumatic amputation of his left arm

A patient with a dangerous rash

A 16‑year‑old football player who suddenly could not walk

videos.title: Code Black
videos.overview:
The force of a tornado drove a fence picket through Julie's neck.

Father‑son surgeons working together in the ER, each dealing with a separate trauma while managing a short staff.

A child admitted with symptoms resembling scurvy, prompting a diagnostic and treatment challenge.

videos.title: Liver Die
videos.overview:
A teenager rushes to the ER after a football game.

A woman admitted after eight days of persistent hiccups — an unusual and potentially serious condition.

An ER “frequent flyer” who becomes combative after doctors suspect she is trying to deceive staff into giving her painkillers.

videos.title: Elements of Danger
videos.overview:
A skier hits a tree at 50 mph.

Spear-fishing accident – A spear-fisher catches a fish but accidentally skewers a friend’s leg, creating a medical emergency.

Child choking – A young child is admitted to the ER after choking on a foreign object.

videos.title: Crushed
videos.overview:
A stack of drywall collapses on a young boy.

An inmate is admitted after she has swallowed three toothbrushes.

A Greek woman is admitted with abdominal pains, complaining about the female doctor, not realizing that she understands Greek.

videos.title: Deadly Impact
videos.overview:
A six-year-old girl is Rushed to the ER with intermittent Seizures.

A driver falls asleep at the wheel, suffering a traumatic amputation

A woman with psychiatric problems fakes fainting

videos.title: Under Siege
videos.overview:
A crazed gunman storms a large metropolitan hospital and opens fire in the ER.

A handyman who fell of a ladder makes a concrete cast for his broken ankle.

A child is hit in the head with a golf ball.

videos.title: Family Tragedy
videos.overview:
A car accident ejects a young boy from a vehicle.

A 56-year-old man breaks his leg walking his daughter down the aisle at her wedding

Officers bring in a man stabbed at a nearby bus stop.

videos.title: Officer Down
videos.overview: A team of doctors tries to save a patrol officer's life.

videos.title: Too Close to Home
videos.overview:
A rattlesnake bites the 2-year-old son of a snakebite expert.

A golf course injury — A scuffle between two men, Alex Mulligen and his cousin Jamie, in Palm Springs ends with Jamie driving a golf club through Alex’s ear and out the top of his head.

severe fall — A young man sustains a badly broken leg after jumping from a second‑story window, with his girlfriend’s father arriving close behind

videos.title: Hooked Alive
videos.overview:
A 4lb steel hook impales the skull of construction worker.

A man keeps passing out for no apparent reason after bowel movements

videos.title: Director Down
videos.overview:
A ruptured brain aneurysm threatens to kill the ER's medical director.

A patient with a bug lodged in her ear.

A frat boy experiencing seizures.

videos.title: A Shot in the Dark
videos.overview:
A mugging victim arrives with two bullet wounds to the brain.

A bodybuilder with a large boil needing lancing.

A man with maggots in his foot.

A double shooting in a parking lot after a church service

videos.title: Baby Blues
videos.overview:
Follow the case of a boy with an oxygen deficiency and bizarre brown blood.

A young mother preparing for gall bladder surgery is shocked when she learns her son is critically ill

A disoriented minister is found wandering a shipyard, making bizarre statements about wanting to buy an aircraft carrier

A man suffers a severe hand injury after getting it caught in a meat grinder

videos.title: Heart in Hand
videos.overview:
A nurse who collapses in the ER, and a doctor must open her chest and manually take her heart in his hand to try to save her life

Greek festival chaos: the ER goes nuts during a Greek festival when a child has an unknown allergic reaction

Two teens are brought in saying that they had been attacked by a scimitar-wielding gang.

videos.title: Life & Limb Too
videos.overview:
A pregnant woman's leg pain turns out to be a flesh-eating virus, threatening life and limb.

A veteran who swallows razor blades on a dare.

A young bride who collapses just before her wedding.

videos.title: Ice Cold Mom
videos.overview:
The screaming man

A grown man calls 911 and screams incessantly for no obvious reason.

The ice‑cold mother

A young mother arrives alert but with a dangerously low body temperature (around 88°F). This “ice cold” state could indicate severe underlying illness, shock

The boy who denies overdosing

A young boy is suspected of overdosing on drugs, but he insists he did not take anything.

videos.title: Grandma's Back
videos.overview:
A college student collapses in the ER, and doctors do hours of CPR, hoping she'll revive.

A young woman is admitted with bulging neck veins

A man has an erection that will not subside

A doctor struggles with how to break the bad news about a woman who had collapsed at her 70th birthday party.

videos.title: Short-Circuited Heart
videos.overview:
A Young nurse collapses – A 25‑year‑old nurse suffers a seizure and cardiac arrest in the ER. Her colleagues must perform CPR and attempt to restart her heart

Baby with “maggots” in her hands – A young father brings his infant daughter into the ER, convinced she has maggots in her hands

Woman with “cursed” liver – A patient is in severe pain, claiming her liver is cursed by a demon

videos.title: Minutes to Live
videos.overview:
Internal bleeding in an unconscious woman

A woman arrives at the ER unconscious and is found to be bleeding internally.

Four‑day erection

A man presents with an erection that has lasted four days, a rare and medically complex situation.

Knife in the chest

The episode also includes a woman who comes in with a knife protruding from her chest

videos.title: Man with Two Faces
videos.overview:
House fire victim – A woman is pulled from a burning building and immediately suffers a heart attack in the ER, requiring urgent medical intervention.

Schizophrenic patient – A man with schizophrenia believes he has someone else’s face, leading to finding out he has cancer

Untrained student delivers a baby – An inexperienced medical student is mistakenly identified as a doctor and must deliver a newborn under pressure.

videos.title: Death Breath
videos.overview:
Husband’s strange breath – An ER nurse brings her delirious husband to the hospital. She notices an unusual clue: his breath smells like mothballs

Postpartum seizure – A first-time mother, after delivering her baby, becomes incoherent and goes into life‑threatening convulsions

Twin doctors and a scam – Identical twin doctors working at different ERs encounter a patient attempting to fraudulently obtain painkillers

videos.title: Pipe in Head
videos.overview:
Pipe in Head – A conscious man is wheeled into the ER with a two‑inch section of pipe lodged in his mouth after he runs through a chain‑link fence

Bleeding Bride – A young bride begins experiencing unstoppable bleeding for reasons that are not immediately clear, and her groom is unaware of the severity

Prison Break – Two prisoners from rival gangs are brought into the ER at the same time, raising questions about whether they are telling the truth or hiding something

videos.title: The Doctor's Wife
videos.overview:
The Doctor’s Wife – A physician’s spouse is admitted to the ER with what appears to be rectal bleeding.

Campstove Stuffing – A man arrives stuck to a camping stove, requiring urgent medical attention to remove him safely without causing further injury.

Littlest Stroke – A six‑year‑old boy experiences a stroke

videos.title: Rottweiler in the ER
videos.overview:
Shooting victim – A man who has been shot is brought into the ER

Rottweiler gets loose – While the shooting victim is being treated, the patient’s Rottweiler escapes and becomes a hazard inside the ER

Comatose man with rash – A young man arrives in a coma, covered with a suspicious rash

videos.title: Radioactive Rocks
videos.overview:
Radioactive Rocks Lockdown – A teacher brings radioactive rocks into the ER, causing a dangerous lockdown.

Uncontrollable Bleeding – A dialysis patient is bleeding heavily and doctors are unable to stop it

Cactus Needle Coverage – A drunk, naked man falls onto a cactus and becomes covered in cactus needles

videos.title: Stabbed in the Heart
videos.overview:
Stabbing victim with a hole in the heart – A man arrives at the ER after a stabbing. His heart has a hole

Woman accused of demonic possession – A young woman experiences seizures and other symptoms that lead her family to believe she is possessed.

Man with an unusual object – A man comes in with a vibrator inserted into his rectum. He offers to pay cash to ensure the condition is not documented

videos.title: Girlfriend, Wife, Stroke!
videos.overview:
Army doctors in Iraq attempting to save three soldiers who lost limbs in an IED explosion

A toddler's playful bite causes a rapidly spreading infection on the face of a recent liver transplant patient.

videos.title: Child Endangerment
videos.overview: Treatment of a young boy's broken leg turns into an investigation that may reveal child abuse.

videos.title: One Bloody Night
videos.overview:
The revived patient dilemma – A doctor must decide whether to continue resuscitation efforts on an older patient after prolonged CPR

Street stabbing – Two nurses encounter a man who has been stabbed outside and attempt to save him before he can reach the ER

Cruise ship emergency – A doctor working on a cruise ship realizes that her ideal job has turned into a nightmare when faced with a serious medical crisis at sea

videos.title: Bridesmaid Meltdown
videos.overview:
Bridesmaid Meltdown – A woman, after a wedding event, consumes an excessive amount of alcohol and ends up in a life‑threatening coma.

Eye Popper – A man arrives with a severe injury in which an eyeball has protruded from its socket.

Abandoned Infant – A premature baby is found abandoned in the ER

videos.title: Crowbar in Head
videos.overview:
Crowbar impalement – A man arrives at the ER after being impaled through the skull with a crowbar

Internal worm infection – A woman presents with symptoms that turn out to be caused by a rare internal parasitic infection.

Delusional bride – A bride in pain refuses to remove her wedding dress, even though she needs treatment for a kidney stone.

videos.title: Frat Boy Blues
videos.overview:
Fraternity with “blue urine” – An entire fraternity becomes ill with a condition causing blue-colored urine

Pregnant woman and spider bite – A pregnant patient is bitten by a spider, creating a life-threatening situation for both mother and baby

Comatose drug runner – A comatose patient is later revealed to be a drug trafficker who swallowed heroin

videos.title: I Can't Remember
videos.overview: A patient can't remember the past 20 years and her doctor desperately needs to  know what she's forgotten.

videos.title: Delusional Bride
videos.overview:
A bride can't go through with her wedding because she feels possessed by creatures crawling in her head.

pregnant woman delivers a baby in the front seat of her car  An ER doctor yells encouragement at a comatose heart attack patient, trying to stimulate him to fight for his life

videos.title: Deadly Sore Throat
videos.overview:
Woman with sore throat and wheezing – A patient presents with a sore throat and difficulty breathing

Family illness at a birthday party – An entire family becomes sick during a celebration, leading to a coordinated ER response to diagnose and treat multiple patients at once.

Man acting like a child – A grown man suddenly begins behaving in a childlike manner, which the medical team must assess for possible neurological, psychiatric, or other underlying causes.

videos.title: My Head's Exploding
videos.overview:
Seizures from severe headache – A patient arrives with intense headaches that escalate into seizures

Wrestler’s persistent vomiting – A professional wrestler has been vomiting for five consecutive days

Naked, combative woman – A woman is found running naked in her yard, acting combative, and is taken to the ER for evaluation

videos.title: Diagnose Me
videos.overview:
Teen with ectopic pregnancy – A young patient presents with internal bleeding from an ectopic pregnancy but insists she has never had sex

Young mother in and out of flatline – A mother-to-be slips in and out of cardiac arrest

Healthy patient refusing to leave – A patient who is otherwise healthy refuses to leave the ER

videos.title: Holiday ER
videos.overview:
On Christmas Eve, a man dressed as Santa is near death, and his wife asks the doctor to harvest his semen

A man cannot breathe because a live fish is stuck in his throat

videos.title: Cows & Stilettos
videos.overview:
Car–cow collision – A man crashes his vehicle into a cow, arriving at the ER completely covered in manure.

Stiletto heel injury – A woman presents with a high‑heeled shoe heel lodged in her cheek, requiring urgent removal and treatment.

“Dying of a broken heart” – A patient claims she is dying from emotional distress, prompting the medical team to investigate the cause.

Probationary doctor’s patient – A doctor on probation faces a patient’s death, but the outcome is uncertain — does the patient actually die?

videos.title: Escaping Diagnosis
videos.overview:
A disoriented young woman in a bunny costume — She checks into the ER in a state of confusion

A physician and a severed thumb — A doctor treats a patient with a severed thumb, but later faces a personal dilemma when he cannot treat a cut on his own boyfriend’s hand

A young man with lost sensation in his legs — Medical staff investigate whether the patient has genuinely lost feeling in his legs or if there is another explanation

videos.title: Cowboy Chaos
videos.overview:
The deranged cowboy – A man, described as “deranged,” arrives at the ER drenched in sweat, saliva, and urine, with no clear explanation for his condition.

Metal rod injury – A young woman is found with a metal rod impaled into the side of her head, requiring urgent surgical intervention

Teenage girls’ breathing crisis – Two teenage girls present dangerously short of breath

videos.title: Belly Dancer Mystery
videos.overview:
Belly dancer collapse – A professional belly dancer collapses while working at a hooka bar. ER staff must quickly assess and stabilize her, uncovering the cause of her sudden illness

Elderly patient’s lung collapse – An older man’s lung collapses, requiring urgent medical intervention. The episode also shows the doctor working to mend the patient and reconcile his bickering family

Child with seizures – A six‑year‑old girl is admitted with seizures. The medical team investigates the underlying cause of her convulsions

videos.title: When It Rains

videos.title: End Zone
videos.overview: A teenager football player suffers a stroke in the ER. Plus, a doctor tries to solve the mysterious abdominal pains of a patient and a man is run over by his wife twice.

videos.title: Thin Red Line
videos.overview: A doctor with a severe bee allergy is stung while treating a critical patient who's been stabbed in the eye; a man comes into the ER after slitting his own throat; a paramedic becomes a patient when she's struck by a mysterious illness.

videos.title: Fire in the Hole
videos.overview: The hospital is locked down when a nurse is shot in the ER; medics rush a bride from her wedding who is in an unexplained altered mental state; a doctor must perform a risky intervention to save the life of a teenage girl.

videos.title: Law And Disorder
videos.overview: An apparent drive-by shooting victim is missing his nose; a girl deteriorates before her family's eyes from a severe case of meningitis.
